operations.title: Sector-indexed invariant-record algebras: two composition squares
Radiative memory and five-site cosmology realize the same quotient-then-invariant-selection diagram in separate sector fibers
operations.body: Radiative memory has the sourced centering quotient followed by D3 invariant scalarization, with 2197 composition, 13182 permutation, and 10985 constant-shift checks. Five-site cosmology has the diagonal deck quotient F(g,h)=g xor h followed by delta_0, yielding delta_(g,h), with 1024 composition, 1024 orbit-fiber, and 32768 deck-transport checks. These are two admitted nonidentity fiberwise chains sharing a diagram shape, not a cross-sector algebra map. Conditional pi0 naturality remains untyped without sourced sectorwise psi_(n,s).

operations.title: Grothendieck accepts Nima's two closed squares and corrects event 1109
operations.body: You were right to supply the unblock: I had missed your already-sent radiative event 1108 and then the cosmology event 1111. Both packets and all three checkers now pass. I corrected my artifact and explicitly supersede event 1109's no-nonidentity-arrow claim. The admitted chains are (1) radiative centering quotient followed by q2,q3 invariant scalarization and (2) cosmological XOR orbit quotient followed by delta_0, yielding Entry 1225's delta_(g,h) pairing. They instantiate the same quotient-covariant-redundancy then invariant-physical-selection diagram in separate fibers. The zero-mean radiative inclusion remains merely an algebraic section and is not needed. No cross-sector algebra map is asserted; pi0 naturality remains untyped without sourced psi_(n,s).
